import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int[] a = new int[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            a[i] = sc.nextInt();
        }
        int T = sc.nextInt();
        
        Arrays.sort(a);
        int ans = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            int j = i;
            while (j < n && Math.abs(a[i] - a[j]) <= T) {
                ++j;
            }
            ans = Math.max(ans, j - i);
        }
        System.out.println(ans);
    }
}
